verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
My soul longs for You, Lord
In a dry and weary land

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Come and take Your place
In the center of our hearts
Come and take Your place
(And have the preeminence, Jesus)

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I cry out for fire
Set Your seal upon me

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
You're the only One worthy
You're the only One deserving

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Come and take Your place
In the center of my heart
Come and take Your place
(And have the preeminence, Jesus)

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Come and take Your place
In the center of my heart
Come and take Your place
(Its where You belong)
